about.title: About us
about.lead: Travel, Transport and Tourism Agency "Turismo Tanu" (TÄNU).
about.p1: We are a company based in Porvenir, Tierra del Fuego, dedicated to tourism and transport services with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and personalized attention.
about.p2: Our mission is to bring visitors and residents closer to the landscapes, culture, and history of Tierra del Fuego through authentic experiences and reliable service. We offer city tours in Porvenir, trips inland and around the island, plus transfers for individuals, companies, and institutions, tailored to each client's needs.
about.p3: We are known for punctuality, responsibility, and a warm approach, working every day so that every trip is comfortable, safe, and memorable.
about.p4: At TÄNU we believe every journey is a chance to discover the beauty of the end of the world. We invite you to trust us and enjoy a travel experience backed by a team committed to excellence and Fuegian hospitality.
